'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' is an [[NPC]] on {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} in the [[Rift Dimension]]. They give the player a {{Skill|Mining}}-related quest outside the Rift in exchange for {{Item|Eleanor's Slippers}}.

== Purpose ==
'''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' gives the player a {{Skill|Mining}} quest that they must complete outside the Rift.

Behind the nearby mirror, a replica of the player is equipped with {{Item|Heat Armor}} and a {{Lv|1}} {{Item|Silverfish Pet|rarity=leg}} while mining {{Item|Cobblestone}} with a [[Drill]] in the {{Zone|Slimehill}}.

To complete the quest, all of the following conditions must be met at the same time:
*Wear a full set of {{Item|Heat Armor}}, {{Item|Flamebreaker Armor}}, {{Item|Sorrow Armor}}, or {{Item|Armor of Divan}}.
*Equip an {{Item|Armadillo Pet}}, {{Item|Mithril Golem Pet}}, {{Item|Scatha Pet}}, {{Item|Silverfish Pet}}, or {{Item|Snail Pet}} of {{Legendary}} rarity or higher.
*Hold a [[Drill]] of any type.
*Be between {{Coords|32|64|27}} and {{Coords|52|75|3}} in the {{Zone|Slimehill}}.
*Sneak twice within one second.

Once completed, the message "''{{Mctxt|f|You sense a watchful presence...}}''" will appear in chat. The player can then return to '''Madame Eleanor Q. Goldsworth I''' to claim {{Item|Eleanor's Slippers}}.
